feature.name: first_hour_semiconductor_peer_positive_fraction_3
feature.formula: For each peer require exactly 12 5min bars, finite positive first 09:35 open and last 10:30 close, positive finite open/close in all 12 bars and price_valid==1. Compute log(close_10:30/open_09:35)>0 for each; feature is fraction positive among exactly the three fixed peers. Zero return counts nonpositive. No smoothing, threshold selection, ETF weighting or future bar.
feature.assumed_available_at: 10:31 America/New_York, one minute after last completed right-labelled peer bar
